interfaces.signature: interface INotification { _id: string; type: NotificationType; actor: IUserPublic; target?: { post_id?: string; comment_id?: string; post_title?: string; comment_preview?: string }; read: boolean; created_at: Date }
preconditions: Notification record exists in the notifications collection
postconditions: Type-safe access to all notification fields in frontend code

failure_modes.trigger: Dangling target reference (post or comment was deleted after notification creation)
failure_modes.behavior: target fields are undefined; UI renders a degraded card with just the action text, no deeplink

test_contracts.scenario: Notification with deleted target post renders without crash
test_contracts.verifies: target is optional and UI handles undefined

extension_points: NotificationType enum is extensible: comment, reply, like, follow, system
sealed_points: _id, created_at, read fields — standard CRUD fields, no customization needed

preconditions: Valid notification record with all required fields
postconditions: Notification record persisted with server-generated _id and created_at

failure_modes.behavior: Error logged, notification silently dropped (non-blocking for the triggering action)
failure_modes.propagation: Caller (comments-cloud) catches and logs, does not fail the comment creation

test_contracts.scenario: Notification creation fails but comment creation still succeeds

failure_modes.trigger: Duplicate notification (same actor, same target, same type within a time window)
failure_modes.behavior: Write is skipped if an existing unread notification matches (idempotency check)

test_contracts.scenario: Second identical comment creates only one notification

extension_points: Notification type enum drives which fields are populated in target
sealed_points: Collection name is 'notifications' — no parameterization needed
state_owned: All notification records in the notifications collection

interfaces.signature: listNotifications(openid: string, before?: string, limit?: number) -> { notifications: INotification[], hasMore: boolean }
preconditions: openid is a valid authenticated user
postconditions: Returns up to 'limit' notifications for the user, sorted by created_at desc, cursor-paginated via 'before' timestamp

failure_modes.trigger: Database query timeout or connection error
failure_modes.behavior: Return fail('查询失败', 'QUERY_ERROR') with error logged
failure_modes.propagation: notifications-service catches, surfaces as error state on the page

test_contracts.scenario: Network error during notification fetch shows error state with retry

failure_modes.trigger: Pagination cursor 'before' references a deleted or non-existent notification
failure_modes.behavior: Returns empty array with hasMore: false (graceful degradation)

test_contracts.scenario: Invalid pagination cursor returns empty result

interfaces.signature: markNotificationsRead(openid: string, notificationIds?: string[]) -> { updated: number }
preconditions: openid is a valid authenticated user
notificationIds are owned by this user
postconditions: Specified notifications (or all unread if no ids) marked as read=true

failure_modes.trigger: Update query matches zero documents (already read or invalid ids)
failure_modes.propagation: Caller treats as success (idempotent read marking)

interfaces.signature: createNotification(openid: string, data: { type: NotificationType; targetUserId: string; targetPostId?: string; targetCommentId?: string }) -> { notification: INotification, status: string }
preconditions: Caller is a cloud function (comments-cloud or posts-cloud)
targetUserId exists and is not the same as the actor
postconditions: Notification record created with actor snapshot from caller's user record, read: false, server timestamp

failure_modes.trigger: Actor is the same as target user (e.g. commenting on own post)
failure_modes.behavior: Notification creation silently skipped, returns status: 'self_target'
failure_modes.propagation: Caller treats as success (don't notify users about their own actions)

test_contracts.scenario: Commenting on own post does not create a notification

failure_modes.trigger: Anonymous actor — notification must show anonymous identity
failure_modes.behavior: Actor snapshot stored with nickname: '匿名用户', avatar_url: '' regardless of real identity
failure_modes.propagation: notification-card renders anonymous avatar and name

test_contracts.scenario: Anonymous comment notification hides real identity

extension_points: New notification types added via the NotificationType enum
createNotification accepts extensible data payload per type
sealed_points: Collection name and index strategy are fixed
state_shared: Notifications collection (shared with comments-cloud for writes)

interfaces.signature: listNotifications(before?: string, limit?: number) -> Promise<{ notifications: INotification[], hasMore: boolean }>
postconditions: Returns paginated notification list, most recent first

failure_modes.behavior: Promise rejects with Error; caller sets page state to 'error'
failure_modes.propagation: notifications-page shows error state with retry button

test_contracts.scenario: listNotifications cloud error shows error state

postconditions: Notifications marked as read; returns count updated

failure_modes.behavior: Silently fails (best-effort), does not block UI

test_contracts.scenario: markRead network failure does not crash the page

postconditions: Returns count of unread notifications for badge display

failure_modes.trigger: Cloud function timeout during unread count query
failure_modes.behavior: Returns 0 (degrade gracefully, don't show misleading badge)
failure_modes.propagation: Stub row shows no badge rather than a potentially wrong count

extension_points: Additional notification query methods (filter by type, mark all read)
sealed_points: Underlying cloud function action names are fixed

interfaces.signature: stub-row component: displays unreadCount (number), latestPreview (string), latestTime (Date); emits 'tap' event
preconditions: latestPreview and latestTime come from the most recent unread notification (or empty if none)
postconditions: Renders a list row visually consistent with conversation rows: icon + title + preview + time + badge

failure_modes.trigger: unreadCount is 0 and there are no notifications at all
failure_modes.behavior: Stub row renders without badge, preview shows '暂无新消息'
failure_modes.propagation: User sees a neutral empty state, tapping still navigates to notifications page

test_contracts.scenario: Stub row with zero notifications shows neutral text

extension_points: Stub row icon can be customized
Badge style follows conversation badge style for visual consistency
sealed_points: Position: always index 0 of the messages page list

interfaces.signature: notification-card component: receives notification: INotification; emits 'tap' event with notification data for deeplink navigation
preconditions: notification is a valid INotification object with at least type, actor, and created_at
postconditions: Renders a card with: actor avatar + name, action text (per type), target preview (if available), relative timestamp

failure_modes.behavior: Card renders without target preview and without deeplink; action text still shows
failure_modes.propagation: Tap does nothing (no navigation to deleted content)

test_contracts.scenario: Notification for deleted post renders card without target preview

failure_modes.trigger: Unknown notification type (future enum value added but card not updated)
failure_modes.behavior: Renders a generic card with actor name and '与你互动了' fallback text
failure_modes.propagation: Future-proof: new types render something rather than blank

test_contracts.scenario: Unknown notification type renders generic fallback card

extension_points: Per-type card template is extensible: each NotificationType maps to a template partial
Deeplink logic per type: comment -> post page, reply -> post page scrolled to comment, follow -> profile page
sealed_points: Card structure (avatar + text + time) is consistent across types for scanability

interfaces.signature: Page: notifications/notifications with scroll-view feed, pull-to-refresh, infinite scroll pagination
preconditions: User is logged in and navigated from messages page Stub row
postconditions: Renders paginated list of notification-card components
Marks all visible notifications as read on page enter

failure_modes.trigger: Initial load returns empty (no notifications ever created)
failure_modes.behavior: Shows empty state: '暂无消息通知'
failure_modes.propagation: User sees empty state, can navigate back

test_contracts.scenario: Empty notification feed shows empty state

failure_modes.behavior: Shows inline error toast '加载失败', user can scroll up and retry by pulling down
failure_modes.propagation: Existing notifications remain visible; error does not clear the list

test_contracts.scenario: Pagination network error shows inline error, preserves existing items

extension_points: New notification type templates added to the notification-card component without page changes
sealed_points: Navigation entry point: only from messages page Stub row
state_owned: notification list state (loaded items, hasMore flag, pagination cursor)

interfaces.signature: Modified onShow: additionally fetches unread notification count for Stub badge
postconditions: Conversation list rendered with Stub row at position 0
Tab bar badge shows stub unread + total conversation unread

failure_modes.trigger: Unread count fetch fails while conversation list succeeds
failure_modes.behavior: Stub row renders with unreadCount: 0 (no badge), conversation list renders normally
failure_modes.propagation: User can still see and interact with DM conversations

test_contracts.scenario: Unread count query fails but conversation list still renders
test_contracts.verifies: Stub failure does not block DM list

extension_points: Tab bar badge logic supports additional badge sources
sealed_points: Stub row is always at index 0
Messages page is a tab bar page (cannot change route)

interfaces.signature: createComment (modified): after successful comment creation, calls createNotification if comment is top-level (depth 0) and post author is different from commenter
preconditions: Comment was successfully created with status 'published'
postconditions: If applicable, a 'comment' type notification is created for the post author

failure_modes.behavior: Error is logged, comment creation is NOT rolled back, response includes flagged: notification_failed
failure_modes.propagation: Comment succeeds regardless; notification is best-effort

test_contracts.scenario: Notification creation failure does not rollback comment

extension_points: Other comment actions (reply, like) can emit their own notification types
sealed_points: Only top-level comments (depth=0) create notifications in initial implementation; replies are out of scope
